text:
mina: FYI starting a cost-aware canary for the new sampling scorer flag in eu-central at 01:30 UTC. Primary goal is to validate accuracy without unexpected cost drift. Plan: tiny ramp with strict budget cap.

ryan: Can you share the steps?

mina: Steps are 1% -> 4% -> 12% with holds 6m, 10m. Auto-rollback if cost-per-req increases >15% vs baseline OR p95>180ms. We'll tag cohort with header `X-Cohort=cost-canary`. Pin service image `scorer:2.4.0-cost` for cohort.

mina: Rollout payload: ```json
{"strategy":"budgeted-staged","budget_pct":15,"steps":[{"pct":1,"hold":"6m"},{"pct":4,"hold":"10m"},{"pct":12,"hold":"15m"}],"pin":"scorer:2.4.0-cost","rollback_on":["cost_delta>15","p95>180"]}
```

ryan: Good. Ops, can we run an embeddings preload + a 2-min synthetic traffic sweep 8m before step-1 to establish a fresh baseline? Also enable `X-Trace-Tag: cost-canary`.

ops-bot: Preflight: scheduled `embed-preload/cost-canary` at 2026-04-07T01:22:00Z and synthetic sweep queued at 2026-04-07T01:24:00Z. Infra check: available headroom confirmed. Will post completion.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled: `ffctl set scorer-sample --env=eu-central` JobID: jb-8802 ETA 2026-04-07T01:30:00Z. Release note link: https://redwood.internal/releases/scorer-costcanary-2026-04-07.

mina: Alerts: cost-per-req baseline attached in dashboard link. p95 alert 180ms, error rate alert 1%. If auto-backoff triggers, deploy-bot will step down to previous step and extend hold +12m. If step-down still fails, escalate to oncall.

deploy-bot: Auto-backoff policy enabled. Behavior: on threshold breach -> step down once + extend hold -> attempt one auto-recover after drain -> if still unhealthy, mark rollout `manual-rollback-needed` and page oncall. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/budgeted-canary-backoff.

product-bot: Added release blurb to PR and notified product owners. Notifying finance for the temporary budget window.

oncall-bot: Oncall rota will be paged on escalation. Current oncall: ryan.

ryan: I'll monitor cost telemetry and SLOs. If manual rollback required, I'll run `ffctl rollback scorer-sample --to=0%` and coordinate incident notes.

mina: Quick note: ensure `scorer.fallback=baseline` is enabled so we don't drop requests. Also set sample-rate=0.5% trace sampling for the cohort.

ops-bot: Confirmed fallback flag and trace-sampling config applied to rollout job. Preflight completed: preload ok, synthetic sweep completed, baseline metrics captured.

mina: Final checklist: pin image, set budgeted payload, schedule preload+sweep, enable headers/traces, confirm alerts, confirm oncall. Starting in ~7m.

ryan: SGTM, I'll post metric snapshots at each holdpoint and capture cost deltas.

mina: Thanks all. If we see any cost regression or latency spike, prefer early rollback to protect budget.
